title: Bork
summary: A Flutter app concept to help dog owners find nearby playmates and make it easier for dogs to socialise.
description: The goal: make it easier for dogs to find nearby playmates, especially where welcoming dog-owner communities can be hard to find in Singapore.
My first direction was friendly pastels. After attending pet fairs, I realised that look felt out of context.
On 2026-11-22, I began exploring a summer-beach theme: tropical to Singapore, easier on the eyes, and a better match for the icon featuring my friend's dog.

Built so far: Flutter/Dart onboarding and welcome screens, a custom theme, and an app icon. Authentication, profiles, nearby discovery and matching, messaging, and backend services are planned—not implemented.

updates.title: Rethinking the visual direction
updates.details: After attending pet fairs, I realised my initial friendly pastel direction felt out of context for the experience I wanted. I started shifting toward a summer-beach look: tropical to Singapore, easier on the eyes, and a better fit for the app icon featuring my friend's dog. The theme and app remain in progress. Authentication, profiles, nearby discovery and matching, messaging, and backend services are still planned.
